verdict.rationale: The pricing page explicitly lists 'MCP server | Yes | Yes | Yes' confirming an official MCP server is offered across plans, and Twenty's AI agent framework docs describe permission-scoped agents operating within the CRM, which aligns with MCP-style agent connectivity. However, no documentation excerpt details setup, configuration, or hands-on usage of the MCP server itself, leaving the claim thin and unverified by independent evidence.
